mostWorthwhile.text: Filtering the blood and then recovering useful substances made the kidney's job clearer than filtering alone would have.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the ureters and bladder was straightforward progress, but less thought-provoking than the filtering sequence.

surprise.text: I was surprised that useful glucose and water pass through the filter along with wastes and must be taken back.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals explained the pairings, including the kidney's named slots.

continue.text: I would choose to continue for another chapter: seeing the filter and recovery steps connect to the body's urine route was interesting, though the assembly steps were fairly predictable.
